# Each function with a Verus specification that the server's entries don't reach yet (out/VERIFICATION_PLAN.md's Verus
# gate; the owner, 2026-11-09), by file (relative to the workspace), name, and its signature with its clauses, as
# verus-proofs.tsv writes them: a crate's landing adds the lines of its functions whose callers come with a later
# crate, each with PRevPF's YES, and the gate refuses a line whose function is reached, gone, or changed, so a line
# goes with the landing that first calls its function. The list is empty before the storage base passes its gate.
# Only the coordinator's refs change this file.
# file
chunks/src/chunk.rs
column3: fn clone(&self) -> (chunk: Chunk) ensures chunk.address_view() == self.address_view(), chunk.bytes_view() == self.bytes_view(), chunk.hashed_view() == self.hashed_view(),

column1: chunks/src/packs/follow.rs
column3: fn ask(&mut self, with: &mut C, from: &(u64, u64)) -> (answer: core::result::Result< Found<Locator>, E, >) ensures forall|place: (u64, u64), to: Locator| #[trigger] final(self).leads(place, to) == old(self).leads(place, to), forall|place: (u64, u64)| #[trigger] final(self).ends(place) == old(self).ends(place), match answer
